description: Election Commission - Declare that H. M. U. H. B. Wijesinghe as Member of the Yatiwatta P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Yatawatta Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members, which falls squarely under the Elections classification category.
